name: idle_appeal_B
note: Figure-pose lane, POSE CONCEPT B 'glaive across the shoulders' (DESIGN 3.5; art-rules/pose.md). Kept sub-variant B5 of B1-B6 (review/rosace/art/figure-pose/explore/B/). The glaive rests behind the neck across both shoulders, riding the shoulder line plus 6 deg (a 22 deg diagonal on screen), blade to her left so it rises over the bust side; both wrists draped over the haft with the hands hanging relaxed in front of it: the far arm open along the haft to the rose disc, the near arm bent with the hand under the haft (the glaive-hands lane redraws the hands; pose only). Weight on the near (right) leg, straight, ankle under the pit of the neck; the hip pushed out on the back contour; the free left leg out and forward on its toe with the knee in (a lambda, heels 36.5 px apart at 144). Pelvis 54 / chest 42 / head 17 deg from the camera, chest lifted and arched 11 deg, shoulders 13 deg against hips 9 deg, head tilted 8.5 deg against the shoulders with the chin down. 3D cheat (PS-P20): the free leg is scaled 1.10 so the wide lambda is reachable with a straight weight leg (without it the heel gap tops out at ~19-27 px). Weapon and wrist numbers were seated on the posed neck and shoulder line by work/B/place.py; if the torso changes, re-seat them.
